features.name: force-light-mode
features.description: Homepage always renders in light mode regardless of the browser/OS prefers-color-scheme setting; PrimeNG darkModeSelector is set to 'none' in src/app/app.config.ts. Fixes Issue #49.

features.name: gdrive-evidence-subfolder
features.description: scripts/attach-issue-evidence.sh now uploads test-evidence zips into a per-issue Google Drive subfolder named issue-<number> under GDRIVE_FOLDER_ID (created on first use, reused thereafter) instead of dumping all zips into the shared root folder. Fixes Issue #51.
